rows.grounds: compound object of gṛhītvā; accusative plural
locative indicating where items are held
absolutive expressing prior action before uccaret

items.question: What ritual action must accompany holding water, unbroken rice, and sesame in the hand?
premises: Water, unbroken rice, and sesame are taken into the hand.
Taking these items precedes the prescribed verbal act.
The mantra is the object to be uttered.
items.inference: After taking water, unbroken rice, and sesame in the hand, one should recite the mantra.
items.plain_english: Having taken water, unbroken rice, and sesame in the hand, one should recite the mantra.
